{dr}bright glowing object, speeding across the night sky, stopped suddenly, ascends into portal & disappears

i had guest that evening, there were 7 of us altogether. it was just an informal gathering of friends. Five were leaving the state permanently, so it was friends of over 20 years saying goodbye.
I live near a lake, we were standing in the front yard, talking & looking up at the stars. there are no street lights & it was around midnight so there was not lights from the few other homes on the lake. It was a beautiful, clear starry night. i glanced up & saw a shiny, star bright object streaking across the sky, moving from west to east, so fast it was difficult to keep up with. i called attention to it to my friends. we all engaged in a conversation about what it was. absolutely to fast to be a conventional aircraft. bright glowing light a few thought might be the ISS, until it made a sudden course correction from west to south east, without slowing down. then it started to slow down. When it was almost over my home it came to a stop. above it appeared a light, circular in shape, aboute ten times bigger than the ship. it was kinda of strange because you could see stars beyond jnto & around the center. the light was dimmer in this opening, maybe because light was reflecting back. the craft ascended into the center & suddenly disappeared. the portal closed immediately & the sky looked totally normal again.  

.
